maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from AI, cloud, data and digital engineering projects for new platform builds, not repair or servicing of installed bases.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private Fortune 1000 enterprises in retail, finance, pharma, manufacturing and logistics, such as Sysco and AutoZone.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically through engineering services for enterprise clients; only occasional acquisitions, not a roll-up model.

mission_critical.reason: Project-based IT consulting and engineering services; clients can move work to other IT services vendors, though some embedded platform work adds friction.

notes: Mission-critical is a judgment call; engineering services are somewhat switchable but embedded in client systems.
